title: Feather Nest Melody
hook: One bird flies, one swims, one nests close to earth.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: cozy 3D feathers-and-nests storybook, warm twig browns and egg pastels, friendly birds, simple isolated subjects

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child comparing feather and nest functions across bird lifestyles
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written feather/nest function; flightless birds explicit
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: function cue -> recall beat -> target -> soft shape gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a soft woodblock perch-click followed by a small glockenspiel feather answer.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a soft woodblock perch-click followed by a small glockenspiel feather answer
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Feather Nest Melody about what feathers and nests actually do: insulation, flight, waterproofing, display, egg protection and habitat-specific nest design, while flightless birds remain fully feathered birds.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child compares feather function and nesting strategy rather than treating feathers as decoration and nests as one twig cup.
